models_evaluated: machine learning risk score for 7-day heart failure hospitalisation
heuristic rule set from TIM-HF2 (conventional algorithm)

links.outcome: ROC AUC of ML risk score versus conventional heuristic algorithm on the same data

links.quote: The machine learning model significantly outperformed the conventional algorithm (ROCAUC 0.855 vs. 0.727, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Using ML risk scores from telemonitoring data to focus daily clinician review on the highest-risk third of patients (simulated 95% detection of hospitalisations within 7 days)

screen.reason: Evaluates a predictive risk model on trial data and specifically simulates an alert triage practice (reviewing top one-third risk score threshold to reduce manual review workload while capturing 95% of events).

primary.practice: risk alert threshold triage to reduce manual review
